verdict.rationale: Airweave is a context and retrieval layer for agents, so shared-versus-private memory scoping is a fair axis for it. The evidence only shows collections that group data sources and an embeddable Connect widget for end users. Nothing documents sharing selected memory across agents or users while keeping other memory private, and the community RBAC comment is a question, not evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can share selected memory across multiple agents or users (team or group memory) while keeping private memory private
